manual_review_method: Inspected all 11 candidates that passed automatic extraction quality filters, including full extracted text, beginning/end sections, metadata, contributor identities and visible third-party credit markers.
Kept only text payloads; no PDF images, maps, photographs, figures or external data files are included.
Checked UTF-8 replacement-character counts, word counts, text SHA-256 and author affiliation flags.
This is a content review, not a legal opinion and not a substitute for exact cross-source/holdout deduplication.
